g.title: BATTERY
g.text: Lectron Pro 2S. Balance lead goes to the LiPo alarm only.

g.title: XT60
g.text: Unplug = OFF until the power switch is installed.

g.title: SWITCH
g.text: Not installed yet – bridge VIN to VOUT with wire until it arrives.

g.title: MDD20A
g.text: Labels as printed on the board. POWER has NO reverse polarity protection.

g.title: LEFT
g.text: 3 x Wild Thumper gearmotor in parallel

g.title: RIGHT
g.text: 3 x Wild Thumper gearmotor in parallel

g.title: PICO
g.text: powered from Mac USB in Phase 1

g.title: W_CTRL
g.text: jumper wires, bare ends into green screw terminal
Shared ground between Pico and MDD20A is essential.

g.title: ALARM
g.text: Black wire on the "-" pin (the end marked with a minus). Unplug after driving, it slowly drains the battery.
